$comment: Add metadata for every non-$comment top-level declared key and CAPACITY_LEAVES key. Descriptions live only here (max 160 characters). owner is the primary declaring file; the generator lists every declaring file. Record capacity aliases under leaves ($ means the scalar itself). Arrays count as one leaf. toSettle preserves pass-table values; pass C instant means its env-only column indicates an override, not proof of live reload. Pass A was an unquantified baseline inventory of declared settings, platform files, capacity leaves, operator prefs keys and env vars; numeric discovery evidence starts at B. R1076: behavior belongs in product settings; this inventory does not convert constants.
